content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Digital product

A digital product store with no-KYC payments allows creators to sell their digital goods without the limitations imposed by traditional payment processors. This infrastructure provides a way for creators to engage with a global market while maintaining ownership and control over their products and data. By avoiding platforms that charge high fees—such as Gumroad's 10% per sale—creators can significantly improve their profit margins. Moreover, using low-cost payment processors like NOWPayments, which charges only 0.5%, enables creators to retain more revenue, making this approach not just feasible but also financially advantageous.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture of a no-KYC digital product store relies on a combination of free and open-source tools. Hosting services like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages provide a platform to display products, while backend solutions like Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script handle payment processing and product delivery. Order data can be stored in Supabase or Google Sheets, and file delivery can be managed through Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Payment processing is achieved via NOWPayments, which facilitates on-chain cryptocurrency transactions with minimal fees. This stack not only ensures autonomy but also allows for seamless product delivery and management.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is designed specifically for digital creators in regions where conventional payment processors are unavailable or restrictive. Artists, educators, and entrepreneurs in countries like Nigeria, Kenya, and Venezuela can leverage this solution to build their own digital commerce platforms. The architecture empowers these creators to sell digital products—such as ebooks, courses, templates, and software—without the burden of high fees or reliance on third-party platforms. By choosing this route, creators gain the freedom to control their sales, marketing, and distribution processes.
Gumroad's 10% fee can eat into your profits—NOWPayments charges just 0.5%.
The Components That Make It Work Together

A successful no-KYC digital product store is built on several key components that function together seamlessly. The front end is hosted on platforms like GitHub Pages, ensuring that the store is accessible to customers. The backend logic executed via Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script handles payment validation and product delivery. Order management is facilitated through Supabase or Google Sheets, while files are stored and distributed via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Finally, NOWPayments processes payments in over 300 cryptocurrencies, ensuring that creators can accept funds from a global audience while keeping transaction costs low.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To build your own digital product store, start by selecting your hosting service—GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages are excellent options. Next, set up your backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, which will handle payment processing and product delivery. Then, configure your order storage solution using Supabase or Google Sheets. After that, upload your digital products to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for delivery. Finally, integrate NOWPayments for cryptocurrency payment processing, ensuring you have a no-KYC solution in place. For a comprehensive approach, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197) to access all blueprints and templates necessary for deployment.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

You can sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe by deploying a sovereign digital product store that uses cryptocurrency payment processors. By utilizing NOWPayments, you can accept payments in various cryptocurrencies, ensuring seamless transactions without KYC requirements. This method allows you to keep more of your earnings while maintaining full control over your sales process.
Automated delivery means your customers receive products instantly after payment confirmation.

Digital creators selling ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, and beats often reach this infrastructure question after hitting payout restrictions or platform policy problems on Gumroad, Payhip, or Lemon Squeezy. The difference with a sovereign stack is structural: there is no platform relationship to manage, no content policy to comply with, and no payout schedule to wait on. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 deploys the complete infrastructure in 48 hours under your own accounts. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents the build process for creators who prefer to self-deploy. Both are available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Choose your hosting platform, either GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Set up backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Select an order storage solution, such as Supabase or Google Sheets. Upload your digital products to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Integrate NOWPayments to handle cryptocurrency transactions. Ensure your domain is configured for accessibility. Test your setup before launching to the public.

You can sell ebooks by deploying a digital product store that utilizes cryptocurrency payment processors like NOWPayments. This allows you to receive payments without relying on PayPal or Stripe, thus maintaining control and maximizing your profits.

NOWPayments charges a mere 0.5% fee on transactions compared to platforms like Gumroad that take 10%. This significant cost reduction allows creators to retain more revenue from each sale, enhancing their profitability.

Yes, you can sell templates and fonts by utilizing a no-KYC payment solution. By deploying your own digital product store, you can bypass limitations imposed by platforms like Gumroad or Payhip and keep full control of your sales.
What types of products can I sell using this architecture?

You can sell various digital products including ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, beats, plugins, and software. This setup accommodates a wide range of digital goods, providing flexibility for your offerings.
How do I handle product delivery after a purchase?

Product delivery can be automated using Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. When a purchase is confirmed via NOWPayments, the system can automatically provide customers with a download link, ensuring a smooth transaction experience.
